description: Defines the TpTimer class within the WPEFramework::Plugin namespace, implementing a timer with start, stop, and callback functionalities.

classes.name: TpTimer
classes.description: A timer class supporting start, stop, single-shot, interval, and callback functionalities.

methods.name: TpTimer()
methods.description: Constructor initializing the timer with default values.

methods.name: isActive()
methods.description: Returns whether the timer is active.

methods.name: start()
methods.description: Starts the timer with the set interval.

methods.name: start(int msec)
methods.description: Starts the timer with a specified interval in milliseconds.

methods.name: setSingleShot(bool val)
methods.description: Sets whether the timer is single-shot.

methods.name: setInterval(int msec)
methods.description: Sets the timer interval in milliseconds.

methods.name: connect(std::function<void()> callback)
methods.description: Connects a callback function to be called on timeout.

methods.name: Timed()
methods.description: Internal method invoked when the timer times out, executing the callback and restarting if needed.
